permissions.name: draft:read
permissions.reason: See the words you type so a fully typed typo can be corrected.

permissions.name: draft:write
permissions.reason: Register the English inline table; the core applies it, not this plugin.

enabled.description: Opt-in until human validation (phase 30). Off by default.

language.description: Language tag. Only en is shipped; any other value turns correction off.

allow.description: Whitespace- or comma-separated words that must never be corrected.
